05 / REFERENCE DESK

Evidence & limits

What this experiment does: for each available plane, estimate an integer x/y translation from paired landmarks. The output at (x, y) reads the source at (x + Δx, y + Δy). Unsupported edges are null; valid zero intensities remain 0. Navigation follows the physical z positions supplied in the input.

This is a software registration study, not an emulation of SmartAlign or of image acquisition. No beam, vacuum, cutting, stage motion or specimen preparation is simulated. All pixel values and landmarks in the example are authored, not acquired.
